claims.text: The Assembly reports that 'today' (29 December 2014) it elected Tongatapu 1 MP 'Akilisi Pohiva as the new Prime Minister: 15 voted for Pohiva and 11 for Vava'u 16 MP Samiu Kuita Vaipulu. The House was to reconvene on January 20, when the new PM and MPs would take their oath.
claims.uncertainty: The Assembly's selection, not the royal appointment. The 20 January oath is prospective and was not verified. The Speaker election in the same item is not imported.
